visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and glasses sits in a bright indoor restaurant, wearing a green and white striped shirt. He gestures with his hands while speaking animatedly to someone off-camera. In the background, other diners and simple white walls are visible. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a bowl of beef noodles with brown broth and green scallions. Black chopsticks reach into the bowl and lift a portion of noodles. (3) The man returns to the frame with an exaggerated surprised expression, wide eyes, and an open mouth. (4) He holds up a pink 100 Taiwan Dollar bill close to the camera, smiling broadly. Cartoon graphics of money stacks and gold coins float around his head against a white background. (5) He uses chopsticks to eat noodles and continues to speak with high energy, looking directly at the camera. (6) A top-down close-up view shows a large blue and white bowl. A silver spoon and black chopsticks are used to lift and count five distinct chunks of dark brown beef from the soup one by one. (7) The man is shown again, holding a piece of beef on his chopsticks near his face, looking extremely excited as bold text overlays appear on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator speaks quickly over a bouncy, major-key electronic synth BGM. The voice is enthusiastic and projected. (2) A bright, high-pitched 'Ding' sound effect plays precisely as the visual cuts to a food close-up. (3) A fast 'Whoosh' transition sound occurs during the scene change to the man's shocked face. (4) A 'Cha-ching' cash register sound effect rings out as a 100 TWD bill is shown. (5) The narrator continues with high-arousal speech; the BGM remains steady in the background. (6) Five consecutive percussive 'knock' or 'wood block' hits are heard, synchronized with each piece of beef being counted. (7) A loud, processed vocal 'Woo!' sound effect triggers as the video reaches its climax, accompanied by a final synth flourish.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to reveal a high-value food discovery in Taipei: a bowl of beef noodles costing only 100 TWD. It utilizes a high-energy vlog style to prove the quantity and quality of the meal, specifically by counting the beef chunks, to engage viewers looking for budget-friendly dining options.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While it promotes a specific meal price, there is no explicit brand callout or sponsorship disclaimer; it appears to be a personal discovery vlog.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social media editing tropes, such as synchronized sound effects for counting and exaggerated facial expressions, to maintain high retention.
